hold_text: Tier-2: order_monitor close-accounting (the pending broker-pnl sweep) on the live trader; MERGING IS THE DEPLOY (ict-git-sync ~5 min, then a trader restart picks up order_monitor). No order placement, sizing or bracket change: the sweep only READS the venue (one extra entry-order status call on a closed-pnl miss, cached per trade id) and writes pnl/exit_price/notes on rows already closed with pnl NULL. Manager merges.
why: CLOSE-PNL-NULL: bybit_2 (real money) trade 6565 showed P&L '—'. _sweep_pending_pnl_from_bybit matched Bybit's closed-pnl record on the journal's INTENDED entry (0.2492); the venue record carries the FILL (0.2489, 12 bps > 10 bps tolerance), so the venue's own SL record (exit 0.2432, closedPnl -3.28194216) was refused every tick. WATCHDOG-PAST-STOP (2026-10-10) fixed the reconciler and watchdog callers but not this one. Fix: retry once on a miss with the venue entry fill (same in scripts/ops/backfill_monitor_closed_pnl.py); /api/bot/trades/closed maps sl_cross/tp_cross to sl/tp instead of 'other'.
